catalog.cpuSkuGpuFieldsMustBeZero: CPU specs carry no GPU: leave the GPU model empty, set compute share / VRAM / GPUs per instance to 0, and leave the MIG profile blank

catalog.prewarmDisabled: Prewarming is disabled for this image — enable it first
catalog.priceHourlyTwoDecimals: Hourly-billed specs allow at most 2 decimal places (billed per hour at 2 decimals — more digits cause rounding drift); 4-digit precision is only for data-disk GB-month prices
catalog.priceTooSmall: Unit price too small: it rounds to 0 at 0.0001 CNY/hour
catalog.skuBusinessKeyExists: A SKU with the same model, tier, pool, MIG profile, cores share and vCPU/memory already exists — edit that one instead

catalog.tierPoolMismatch: Tier {{tier}} may only run on the {{pools}} pool, but this is {{pool}}
